after: Which decade of publication (e.g., 1980s) has the highest average rating among decades with at least 10 distinct books that have been rated? Return the decade with the highest average rating. When calculating the average rating, each individual review has equal weight. Determine the publication decade using the publication date of the edition corresponding to the book entry in the provided data; if there are multiple editions, use the earliest published edition.
